name: Mir Quick Contact Bubble
author: mirmehranarjmand

sections.description:
Mir Quick Contact Bubble adds a lightweight floating contact menu to your WordPress site.

Contact methods include WhatsApp, Telegram, phone calls, email, SMS, and unlimited custom links. Custom links can use an image selected from the WordPress Media Library, so site owners can use their own service, social, or brand icons.

Features include:

  • Enable or disable the complete bubble.
  • WhatsApp, Telegram, phone, email, SMS, and unlimited custom links.
  • Drag-and-drop button ordering.
  • Custom uploaded icons for any contact button.
  • Prepared messages with {title}, {url}, and {site} placeholders.
  • Desktop and mobile visibility controls.
  • Independent mobile position and spacing.
  • Include and exclude rules by post type, content ID, and URL path.
  • Wildcard URL paths.
  • Working-days and working-hours scheduling based on the WordPress timezone.
  • Hide outside working hours or display an offline message.
  • Bubble, panel, text, and button color controls.
  • Size, spacing, radius, animation, and positioning controls.
  • Live visual preview in the admin area.
  • JSON settings import and export.
  • English source language and bundled Persian translation.
  • RTL-compatible administration and frontend output.

The plugin does not require an external service and does not send visitor data to a third-party API by itself. Clicking a configured contact method sends the visitor to the destination selected by the site administrator.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mir-quick-contact-bubble folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate Mir Quick Contact Bubble.
  3. Open Quick Contact in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Configure your contact buttons, appearance, display rules, and schedule.
sections.faq:
Can I add my own contact or social service?

Yes. Add a Custom Link, enter any valid URL, and select your own icon from the WordPress Media Library.

Can I use an icon downloaded from Flaticon or another icon website?

Yes, provided you have the right to use the icon and the file type is allowed by your WordPress Media Library. The plugin does not bypass WordPress upload security or MIME restrictions.

Does it work on mobile and desktop?

Yes. Each can be enabled or disabled independently, and mobile has separate position, size, and spacing controls.

Can I hide the bubble on checkout or account pages?

Yes. Use excluded content IDs or URL paths. URL rules support * wildcards.

Does the plugin support business hours?

Yes. Choose working days, start and end times, and whether the bubble should be hidden or show an offline message outside those hours. The WordPress timezone is used.
